name: Hontoon Island State Park
coordinateNote: Entrance or parking coordinates from the November 12, 2026 gap review.
navigationDestination: Hontoon Island State Park ferry landing, 2309 River Ridge Road, DeLand, FL 32720
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Park on the mainland, ride the two-to-three-minute ferry across, then hike the shaded nature trail to the big shell mound at its end; the owl-totem replica is visible from the ferry dock. Pairs with Blue Spring manatee viewing a few miles away.
access: Park 8 a.m. to sunset, 365 days. Florida State Parks notice effective Oct 28, 2025: ferry runs 8 a.m. until two hours before sundown, last ferry off the island one hour before sundown (other text on the same page differs; ranger station 386-736-5309). Access only by park ferry or private boat; no cars on the island; no swimming.

name: Serenova Tract primitive campground, Starkey Wilderness Preserve (Southwest Florida Water Management District)
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 12, 2026 research.
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: A 6,533-acre tract with a tent-only primitive campground and the Crockett equestrian/primitive campground, both with picnic tables and fire rings. The entrance is on the south side of SR 52 just west of the Suncoast Parkway, across from Hayes Road. It is the closest free site found to Weeki Wachee for the Nov 22 night.
access: Free permit or reservation required before arrival. Stay limit: 7 consecutive days, 30 days per calendar year Both campgrounds are closed for hunts Nov 25-29 and Dec 3-6, 2026. Open Nov 21-24, Nov 30 - Dec 2 and from Dec 7. Portable toilet and nonpotable water near the campgrounds.
